articles.summary: Japa is an API-first testing framework. It focuses only on testing Node.js (backend) applications, thus resulting in a fast, small, and simple tests runner.
articles.title: Testing your Sails apps with Japa

articles.summary: Sails provides a super useful syntactic sugar for paginating Waterline queries. In this article we will see how to get started using it in your applications.
articles.title: Using the paginate query modifier method for pagination
